name: onemessagebus-visual-docs
//: There is deliberately no capture target: a step that renders a screenshot belongs to no gate (screenshots/AGENTS.md). `lint` parses what this project owns and `test` drives it — the guard and the scripts, with screencomp, freeze and the capture stood in for, so nothing is rendered. Those journeys are Rust and so live in `onemessagebus-repo`'s crate, which is why this project runs them by nextest filter rather than by path; running them here is what makes their reach into this project's scripts and into `onemessagebus-e2e`'s fixture declared edges rather than reach-ins.
